name: Koumon no Hana
source:
Tokyo, high school, senior year.
Infamous otaku Keito sees his world change when a new student arrives: Mei. Our friendless protagonist will try everything to get close to her. But Takeshi, her loathsome "rich-charismatic-handsome" childhood friend, has other plans.

A love triangle is born, but will it really go as expected? Or will you say ''fuckit'' and hang out at the maid café?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250126021655/https://studio-bakanal.itch.io/koumon-no-hana]itch.io[/url]]
